title: Resolve conflicts with the same priority in the order of rules
goal: Let later-written declarations overwrite the same attribute when the priorities are consistent.
summary: device status card already has default background color and padding. You need to change only the background color in the supplementary style, using the same .status selector.
tasks: Write the new .status rule after the existing rule and change the background color to #e6f4ee.

example.note: The rules have the same source, importance and priority, and the color that appears last takes effect.

hint: New rules after existing styles only need to declare the attributes to be overridden.
